description: Physicochemical Input Generator output store for Pharmapolyscope manual entry. One record per entity. Missing values are explicit nulls, never blanks. Empty rows are schema-complete and ready to fill. Values are transferred to Pharmapolyscope manually per SOP step 13 (report Chapter 17).

field_contract.note: INN (drugs) or pharmacopoeial name with grade (polymers)
PubChem-canonical, neutral parent, algorithm version recorded
curated, version-controlled, attachment points explicit; BigSMILES allowed
MANUFACTURER-SPEC from grade datasheet (GPC or K-value conversion documented)
LITERATURE via Table 4-1 priority rule; form identity recorded
CALCULATED 0.70*Tm for drugs (+/- 21 K); LITERATURE grade value for polymers
drugs: CALCULATED Fedors (state qualifier crystalline/amorphous); polymers: bulk density MANUFACTURER-SPEC
COMPUTED-DESCRIPTOR, RDKit Crippen primary, XLogP3 cross-check recorded
generator version incl. pinned RDKit version

diagnostics.title: High Polar Surface Area (> 140 Å²)
diagnostics.molecular_motif: Abundant polar heteroatoms / hydrogen bond acceptors
diagnostics.scientific_rationale: High TPSA indicates potential passive membrane permeation limitations (BCS Class III/IV tendency).
diagnostics.screening_impact: Biological: May necessitate enteric/amorphous stabilization to maximize supersaturation gradient.
diagnostics.remediation_guidance: Examine H-bonding Hansen parameter (delta_H) to ensure strong drug-polymer intermolecular synthon formation.

diagnostics.title: Density Outside Standard Pharmaceutical Range
diagnostics.delta_description: Atypical molecular volume to weight ratio
diagnostics.scientific_rationale: Drug density is outside typical solid-state distributions.
diagnostics.screening_impact: Moderate: Distorts molar volume Vm and HSP dispersion parameter.
diagnostics.remediation_guidance: Provide experimental helium pycnometric density if available.

diagnostics.title: HSP Cross-Method Displacement
diagnostics.molecular_motif: Cyclic lactam / 5-6 membered cyclic amide ring
diagnostics.scientific_rationale: Hoftyzer–van Krevelen and Fedors calculate total solubility parameter delta_t via distinct thermodynamic formalisms (often caused by cyclic lactam/ester ring closure energy offsets). Displacement is within the acceptable [2.0, 5.0] MPa½ band.
diagnostics.screening_impact: Moderate: Minor uncertainty in Hansen distance Ra (approx ± 0.5 MPa½); RED near 1.0 may be sensitive.
diagnostics.remediation_guidance: Run Monte Carlo uncertainty quantification (1,000 runs) during pair screening to assess stability.
